amendments.timing: after raw arm generation, before the first successful summarization

diagnostic_scope: FIXED 100-SAMPLE CV-BENCH SCREENING (screening100) causal diagnostic. It holds the layer-5 cut point, region_grid=3, the unified implementation and the per-sample budget K_C fixed, and changes ONLY the resolved selected_group_indices (control rule vs the frozen historical shallow_r0250 indices). It is explicitly NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion and is NOT an FPGA-deployable candidate: the relaxed K_C alignment is a diagnostic setting only.
round_scope: CPU-only preregistration, summariser and tests. No GPU run, no board run, no training, no hyper-parameter tuning, no network, no dependency installation. The two arm JSONL files are produced later by the host GPU runner exactly as pinned below; they did not exist when this file was written (sha256=null / TO_BE_GENERATED).
experiment_question: Holding the screening100 manifest, the one unified layer-5 forward (evaluation/hardware_regular_layer5_forced_index_ablation.py), the per-sample budget K_C=len(historical selected_group_indices), region_grid=3, BF16/SDPA/greedy decoding and the all-real/no-context emission fixed, does replacing the control selection (one anchor per non-empty 3x3 region + global L2 ranking) with the exact frozen historical shallow_r0250 index set change the official CV-Bench screening100 accuracy? The single experimental variable is selected_group_indices; K_C is identical in both arms by construction.

single_variable_contract.baseline: evaluation/results/cv_bench_l2_budget64_pilot100_20260927/shallow_r0250.jsonl (frozen historical shallow-block r=0.25 reference; supplies K_C and the forced indices only)

single_variable_contract.forced: artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-forced-index-ac/forced_r25_indices_screening100.jsonl (arm=forced, runner keeps exactly the frozen historical indices)
single_variable_contract.same_per_sample_budget: K_C = len(reference.selected_group_indices) is used by BOTH arms and is re-verified per sample
identical: one unified layer-5 forward shared by control and forced (cut=5)
all output slots are raw real 2x2 groups (no context pooling, no context slot reservation, no local candidate cap)
DeepStack index 5 called on the compact hidden
blocks 0..5 full then blocks 6..23 on the compact sequence

no change to BF16 / SDPA / greedy decoding

diagnostic_status.note: The relaxed K_C alignment is deliberate: this is a causal diagnostic, not a deployable configuration.

arms.control: layer-5 control arm: one anchor per non-empty 3x3 region + global L2 ranking, exactly K_C real groups
arms.forced: layer-5 forced arm: exactly the frozen shallow_r0250 historical indices, same K_C

primary_metric.definition: Official CV-Bench combined score returned by the frozen scorer evaluation.build_cv_bench_pruning_report.score: ((accuracy_ADE20K + accuracy_COCO)/2 + accuracy_Omni3D)/2.
primary_metric.rule: This is the ONE and ONLY primary metric for both arms and for the single decision; it is never replaced by any other accuracy.

unweighted_metric.definition: Plain unweighted mean over the 100 screening samples.
unweighted_metric.rule: Secondary diagnostic only. It must never be called the CV-Bench primary score and must never drive the decision.

control.role: layer-5 control arm at the per-sample historical K_C
control.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_layer5_forced_index_ablation.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --reference-jsonl evaluation/results/cv_bench_l2_budget64_pilot100_20260927/shallow_r0250.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-forced-index-ac/control_same_budget_screening100.jsonl --arm control --region-grid 3 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

forced.role: layer-5 forced arm keeping exactly the frozen shallow_r0250 indices at the same K_C
forced.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_layer5_forced_index_ablation.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --reference-jsonl evaluation/results/cv_bench_l2_budget64_pilot100_20260927/shallow_r0250.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-forced-index-ac/forced_r25_indices_screening100.jsonl --arm forced --region-grid 3 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

reference_jsonl.role: frozen historical shallow-block r=0.25 reference; supplies K_C and the forced indices only

validation_requirements.sample_id_identity: The screening manifest, the frozen reference, the control arm and the forced arm must all contain exactly the same 100 sample_id values.
validation_requirements.no_duplicates: Each of the four inputs must contain no duplicate sample_id.
validation_requirements.record_arm_and_flags: Every arm record must declare arm/mode == its own arm, selection_rule == control_global_l2_plus_3x3_anchor (control) or forced_exact_historical_group_indices (forced), only_variable == selected_group_indices, hardware_alignment_relaxed_for_diagnostic == true, causal_diagnostic_only == true and fpga_deployable_candidate == false.
validation_requirements.record_hashes: Every arm record's manifest_sha256 and reference_jsonl_sha256 must equal the actual input file digests; the embedded reference_selected_group_indices and their SHA-256 must reproduce the frozen reference file.
validation_requirements.kc_and_g: Every arm record's K_C / reference_K_C / reference_llm_visual_tokens / requested_K_C / llm_visual_tokens must agree with the reference K_C; full_llm_visual_tokens / baseline_llm_visual_tokens / reference_G / reference_baseline_llm_visual_tokens must agree with the reference G.
validation_requirements.forced_equals_reference: The forced arm's selected_group_indices must exactly equal the frozen reference indices for every sample.
validation_requirements.same_K_control_forced: For every sample the control and forced arms must emit the same number of real groups equal to K_C.
validation_requirements.run_metadata: Every record's run metadata and decoding must be BF16 / sdpa / greedy_argmax with do_sample=false; no B1-trained Wv, no projection, no context pooling / slot reservation / local candidate cap.
validation_requirements.all_real_no_context: Both arms must be all-real (source_type all 0), context_group_count == 0 and real_group_count == output_group_count.
validation_requirements.input_sha256: Every non-null inputs_sha256 pin in this file is re-verified before scoring; the two arm pins are null (TO_BE_GENERATED) and are generated after preregistration.
validation_requirements.fail_closed: If any required input file is missing, or any of the checks above fails, the summariser must raise and must NOT write a report.

decision_rule.note: The only decision is the forced-minus-control 95% paired stratified bootstrap CI lower bound on the official primary metric. This is a screening100 causal diagnostic; it makes no full-dataset (2638-sample) claim.

explicit_non_formal_statement: Fixed 100-sample screening causal diagnostic: the forced vs control signal is diagnostic only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. It must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach.
limitations: Screening100 is a fixed diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample benchmark.
The relaxed K_C alignment is diagnostic only; this is explicitly not an FPGA-deployable candidate.
Both arms run the same unified forward; the only variable is selected_group_indices, and K_C is re-verified to be identical.
Forbidden primary metrics (pointing/grounding/ndcg/retained_mass) are never reported.
Timings are descriptive only and never enter the decision.
Neither arm uses the B1-trained Wv projection.
